evals.name: openapi-archetype-4-hetzner
evals.prompt: I want a skill for integrating Hetzner Cloud into my Python service. Docs: https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/. Read-only scope.
evals.expected_output: Workspace at ~/.claude/skill-from-docs/api.hetzner.cloud/ with valid docs.md (canonical H2s; per-tag H3s under ## API reference), handoff.json carrying archetype_primary=4 and all five OpenAPI content_shape_signals populated, source-map.json, and at least the Locations endpoint probed (with a real Hetzner token) or seeded from hcloud-offline fixtures (without one).

evals.name: well-structured-archetype-1-stripe
evals.prompt: Make a skill from the Stripe API docs: https://docs.stripe.com/api. Node target, create-payment-intent scope.
evals.expected_output: Workspace with docs.md covering payment-intents endpoints; archetype_primary=1; handoff.json has_openapi_spec=true (Stripe publishes OpenAPI) but full archetype-4 signal set not required for non-probing harvests.

evals.name: multi-source-archetype-3-fusesoc
evals.prompt: Make a skill for FuseSoC. Docs: https://fusesoc.readthedocs.io. Python library mode.
evals.expected_output: Workspace with docs.md merging ReadTheDocs + GitHub /examples + CLI --help captures; archetype_primary=3; no OpenAPI signals required.
